recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the remaining current-core correction for FHIR-20698 and should be reflected in generated outputs during the normal build; do not move operational subsetting guidance to meta.security without a new WG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-20698 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for the SUBSETTED marker used for subsetted search results to have a predictable code system, with the final resolution adding v3-ObservationValue/SUBSETTED to Common Tags for Meta.tag and changing the search guidance to say servers should populate meta.tag with the SUBSETTED code.
initial_application: Historical commit 8ea9cdd184a4864604469b328d340fe471894c8c added SUBSETTED to source/datatypes/valueset-common-tags.xml and updated source/search.html; commit 57319124bb1723e443ac213e6cec95cc1fbd4e9a fixed the SUBSETTED link to deep-link into THO. Current source retained the value set include and THO link, but source/search.html still had malformed _summary wording and generic _elements wording that did not explicitly name meta.tag.
additional_context: Zulip and Security WG minutes resolved the earlier meta.security versus meta.tag ambiguity: operational subsetting from _summary or _elements belongs in meta.tag, while meta.security is appropriate for security/privacy-policy subsetting. FHIR-5694 and FHIR-48778 are already represented on the combined branch and support the same current shape: SUBSETTED remains available from external v3 terminology and Meta.tag prefers common-tags.
reconciliation: Edited source/search.html so the _summary and _elements guidance both say servers SHOULD mark resources by populating meta.tag with the SUBSETTED code, preserving the existing THO deep link. No change was needed to source/datatypes/valueset-common-tags.xml or source/datatypes/meta.xml.
source_changes: source/search.html: corrected the malformed _summary sentence from 'mark the by populating meta.tag resources' to 'mark the resources by populating meta.tag with the code SUBSETTED'.
source/search.html: changed the parallel _elements guidance from generic 'with the tag SUBSETTED' wording to the same explicit meta.tag wording.
